components.asset_hash_scope: canonical mergeable ranks and special-token map; pipeline settings are recorded separately

provenance.boundary_note: Piece byte overlap is descriptive. Equal pieces do not imply equal in-context segmentation.
provenance.types_note: Categories overlap. Code-associated and emoji-candidate labels are heuristics, not capability scores.

acquisition.verification: All four redistributed files have the same Git blob IDs as Meta; reconstructed rank file matches Meta original/tokenizer.model SHA-256.

provenance.special_token_policy: Literal special spellings are ordinary text; no automatic BOS/EOS or chat template.
provenance.wrapper_chunking: Meta reference: 400,000-character slices; split whitespace/non-whitespace runs at 25,000 characters.

hardware.timing_note: Same host, native tokenizer only; one warm-up then timed repeats. No model inference.

runtime.memory_scope: Fresh process, excluding vocabulary classification. Native JSON/tiktoken engines; legacy ports include their adapter lookup structures. Process RSS and incremental RSS reported; peak sampled every 5 ms.
